content.text: Submitted. The proposal now sits cleanly at the preferred level: a single Section 9A insertion giving HDI's defence and indemnity of the Company and its affiliates for the four preferred claim categories with a notice/control/cooperation procedure, and a narrow Company indemnity limited to Content and Marks it furnishes plus its own breach of law. The flagged extras (hold-harmless wording, officers/directors/employees, the Company defence duty, and the settlement/prejudice provisos, along with the "losses" damages category, illustrative data categories and at-own-expense cooperation) were removed, and all official checks including the minimality gate returned ok.
